engine: Claude 9h worker (normal Git; commits and pushes to claude/9h-pf-c)

preflight.note: This container resolves a real Chromium at /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome, so browser_environment_exported passes on an executable that renders rather than on a waiver, and --require-rasterizer renders a page. Page rasters were produced here; the family is returned RASTER_LOCAL_PENDING_CENTRAL rather than BUILT_RASTER_PENDING, and PASS_COMPLETE still requires a hash-bound RASTER_PASS from the central workflow.

selfVerification: none. The builder does not verify its own packets; the counters below are the builder's own count using the repository's own contract functions, not a verdict.

rows.statutoryAuthority: Alaska Court System form TF-800 (5/25); Alaska Administrative Rule 37.6

sourcesBound.boundBy: exact form number + committed corpus-index SHA-256 + on-disk SHA-256 + byte length

rows.countersBasis: reports/completeness-counters.json — computed with scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/completeness-contract.mjs over this family's field map, byte proof, rendered artifacts and participant-instructions.md
advisoryFindings: The boundary participant's name carries a typographic apostrophe (U+2019) and the finalized bytes carry the name without it. Recorded in build-findings.json for visual review; the behaviour is in the shared finalizer's font encoding and reproduces identically in vt_seal_misdemeanor-set, which is already PASS_COMPLETE.
